page.layout: One block, centred, on the page: the printer's imprint in four lines. No margins, no notes, no running head or page number.
page.notes: The first line has a large decorative initial B; the second line has a large decorative initial O before "PORINIANA". The "lutis humanæ" line and "Mense Augusto." are in italic type; "M. D. LXXXII." is in small capitals. The final numeral reads LXXXII; the last letter is faint, so it may be a J form. No engraving, stamp or other print on the page.
